## Forma Intime — Home Page: Full Visual Design Direction

### Page Role & Tone
This is the brand's arrival moment. The clinical-health aesthetic must read immediately and without ambiguity: clean, trustworthy, measured, and quietly authoritative. The dashboard-product layout family is interpreted here not as a SaaS dashboard but as a clinical instrument panel — surfaces that organize precision information with calm confidence. Every section must feel like it belongs to the same diagnostic document, not a marketing brochure.

---

### Section Sequence & Rhythm

**Section 1 — Hero:** Full-bleed, commanding, asymmetric. Maximum whitespace. The brand's core promise is the entire visual event. Sparse and still, with one kinetic signature moment.

**Section 2 — Stats:** Dense, data-forward, horizontal strip. Four oversized metric cards in a tight row against a deep Anatomy Blue wash. The numbers dominate — this is the dashboard moment at its most literal.

**Section 3 — Feature Grid:** Structured, airy, three-column panel layout. Each pillar gets a card with generous internal padding. Clinical iconography sits at top-left of each card, not centered. Staggered scroll reveal gives the grid a sense of methodical disclosure.

**Section 4 — CTA Close:** Full-bleed Calibration Ink panel. Warm Forma Nude typographic accent. Centered composition justified by the heritage-close convention — a single, still, confident invitation. The one moment of deliberate symmetry on the page.

The page alternates: sparse → dense → airy → full-bleed dark. This prevents the "identical alternating off-white sections" trap and creates genuine tonal rhythm.

---

### Color & Surface Logic

- **Section 1 (Hero):** Forma White (#F7F8F9) background. Calibration Ink (#1C2B35) for all type. A single horizontal band of Anatomy Blue (#C8DFF0) used as a full-width gradient wash bleeding from the bottom edge of the hero into the stat section — this bridge is the visual tissue connecting the two sections.
- **Section 2 (Stats):** Anatomy Blue (#C8DFF0) as the section background — the palette's 'soft blue' at full expression. Stat numerals in Calibration Ink. Unit labels in IBM Plex Mono in Rigor Teal (#3A8C7E). Card surfaces in Forma White with a 1px Suture Gray (#E2E6EA) border.
- **Section 3 (Feature Grid):** Forma White background. Cards surfaced in Forma White with Suture Gray borders. Icon accent areas use Intime Mint (#B8E4D8) as a small background swatch behind each icon — not the icon color itself, but the icon's tray. The "Read About Our Materials" CTA link in Rigor Teal.
- **Section 4 (CTA Close):** Calibration Ink (#1C2B35) full-bleed background. Headline in Forma Nude (#EDE0D4) — the warm skin-toned neutral surfaces here as a typographic color for the first and only time, creating a quietly sensual contrast against the deep ink. Eyebrow in IBM Plex Mono in Intime Mint. CTA button in Rigor Teal with Forma White label.

---

### Typographic Hierarchy & Expressive Moves

- **Heading font:** DM Sans throughout all headlines. H1 in the hero at 60–64px, bold, sentence case, tight tracking (-0.02em). H2 equivalents at 40–44px in sections 3 and 4.
- **Eyebrow labels:** IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 11–12px, letter-spacing 0.15em — used in all four sections as the clinical documentation register.
- **Stat numerals (Section 2):** DM Sans at 72–80px, bold — oversized to the point of being typographic objects in themselves, not just data labels. This is the most expressive typographic move on the page outside the signature moment.
- **Body/description text:** IBM Plex Sans, 16–17px, line-height 1.7, Precision Slate (#3D4F5C).
- **Section 4 headline:** DM Sans at 48–52px in Forma Nude — the only instance of a warm-toned headline on the page, making it unmistakably a closing note.

---

### Page Signature Moment

**Named:** *The Anatomy Baseline*

**Location:** Hero section (Section 1), running horizontally behind and beneath the main headline.

**Description:** A single ultra-thin horizontal rule — 1px, Anatomy Blue (#C8DFF0) — spans the full width of the hero, positioned at the baseline of the H1 headline, as though the text is resting on a clinical measurement line. The rule extends beyond the text column on both sides, bleeding to the viewport edge. Above the rule on the far right (outside the text column), a small IBM Plex Mono label reads "FI-01 / ANATOMICAL FIT SYSTEM" in 11px Precision Slate at 40% opacity — like a diagram annotation. This is not decorative: it signals that the brand's language is clinical documentation. The rule and annotation are invisible on mobile (collapsed to a single-column layout where the effect would be lost).

**Why it belongs:** The clinical-health aesthetic's visual cues include "clean iconography" and the brand's voice is "precise" and "measured." A clinical diagram baseline is the single most legible metaphor for a brand that maps garments against anatomy. It is minimalist in energy — a bold negative-space gesture and unexpected typographic annotation — appropriate for an editorial/clinical brand that should carry only 2–3 restrained motion moments total.

---

### Motion Design

**Calibration:** 2–3 restrained, purposeful motion moments. This is a clinical-health brand with an editorial sensibility. Motion should feel like a precision instrument powering on, not a consumer app celebrating itself.

**On-Load Arc:**
1. The page arrives with the hero background already present (no fade-in on the surface itself).
2. The eyebrow label ("Precision Intimate Apparel") fades in and slides up 8px over roughly half a second — the first thing the visitor reads.
3. A beat later, the H1 headline fades in and slides up 10px — slightly slower than the eyebrow, giving it weight.
4. The subheadline follows a beat after the headline settles — same fade-slide, slightly softer.
5. The two CTA buttons appear last, fading in together with no slide — they simply materialize, calm and confident.
6. **Signature Motion Moment — The Anatomy Baseline Draw:** After the headline settles (a beat after it finishes fading in), the Anatomy Blue horizontal rule draws itself from left to right across the full viewport width over approximately 0.8 seconds, as if being inscribed by a precise instrument. The diagram annotation label on the far right fades in only after the rule reaches it. This is the page's one kinetic flourish — restrained, clinical, and directly tied to the signature visual moment.

**Scroll-Triggered Reveals:**
- **Section 2 (Stats):** The four stat cards slide up 16px and fade in as the section enters the viewport, staggered left to right — each card a half-beat after the previous. The large numerals count up from zero to their final value over approximately one second once the card is fully visible (a simple vanilla JS counter driven by IntersectionObserver).
- **Section 3 (Feature Grid):** The three feature cards fade in and slide up 12px, staggered left to right, as the section enters the viewport. The icons inside each card appear a half-beat after the card itself — giving the impression of the card populating with content.
- **Section 4 (CTA Close):** The section fades in as a whole (no slide) — its full-bleed dark surface should feel like it arrives, not floats up. The headline and CTA button appear sequentially, eyebrow first, then headline, then button.

**Hover & Focus Affordances:**
- **CTA Buttons (all sections):** On hover, the Rigor Teal background deepens by ~10% and the button lifts 3px with a soft shadow (no blur, just a clean offset). Transition is quick — approximately 150ms. On keyboard focus, a 2px Intime Mint outline appears offset from the button edge.
- **Feature Cards (Section 3):** On hover, the card border transitions from Suture Gray to Intime Mint and the card lifts 4px with a subtle shadow. The icon tray background deepens slightly. Transition is smooth, approximately 200ms.
- **Stat Cards (Section 2):** Deliberately still on hover — they are data, not interactive elements. No lift, no color shift.
- **Navigation links (inherited from shared system):** Underline grows from left on hover.

**Ambient Looped Motion:**
- None. The clinical-health aesthetic and this brand's measured voice do not support ambient looping animation. The page should feel still and confident between interactions. The only "ambient" quality is the static Anatomy Blue gradient wash at the hero-to-stats boundary, which creates a sense of depth without motion.

---

### Responsive Behavior

- **Hero:** Single column on mobile. Anatomy Baseline rule and annotation hidden on mobile. H1 scales to 36–40px. CTAs stack vertically, full-width.
- **Stats:** 2×2 grid on tablet, single column on mobile. Numerals scale to 56px on mobile.
- **Feature Grid:** 3 columns on desktop, 1 column on mobile (cards stack). Stagger animation collapses to a simple sequential fade on mobile.
- **CTA Close:** Centered single column at all breakpoints — this section's symmetry is intentional and scales cleanly.

---

### Fit Within Shared Design System

All color tokens, fonts, and spacing conventions are drawn directly from the shared system. No new colors or fonts are introduced. The page distinguishes itself through: the Anatomy Baseline signature moment (unique to the home page), the oversized stat numerals at 72–80px (the largest type on any page), and the Forma Nude headline in Section 4 (the only warm-toned headline in the site — reserved for this closing emotional note). These moves are available to this page because of its landing role; other pages should not replicate them.

section_design_plans.nl_prompt:
**Section 1 — Hero**

**Layout & Grid:** Full-viewport-height section (min-height 100vh) on a Forma White (#F7F8F9) background. Content is left-aligned in a 12-column grid, with the text block occupying columns 1–7 on desktop. Columns 8–12 are intentionally empty — negative space is a structural choice, not an oversight. The section has generous top padding (120px desktop, 80px mobile) and bottom padding that bleeds into the Anatomy Blue gradient wash connecting to Section 2.

**Eyebrow:** IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 11px, letter-spacing 0.15em, Precision Slate (#3D4F5C) at 70% opacity. Text: 'Precision Intimate Apparel'. Positioned 24px above the H1 baseline. No pill, no background — just the raw mono label.

**Headline (H1):** DM Sans, bold, 60–64px desktop / 36–40px mobile, Calibration Ink (#1C2B35), tracking -0.02em, sentence case. Text: 'Designed for the body. Not the mannequin.' Set across two lines, breaking naturally after 'body.' — the second line 'Not the mannequin.' is slightly shorter, creating an asymmetric stagger that reinforces the off-grid composition.

**Subheadline:** IBM Plex Sans, 18px, line-height 1.7, Precision Slate (#3D4F5C), max-width 520px. Sits 28px below the H1. Text as specified in the section data.

**CTAs:** Two buttons, left-aligned, displayed in a horizontal row with 16px gap. Primary: 'Explore the Collection' — Rigor Teal (#3A8C7E) background, Forma White label, DM Sans medium 15px, 48px height, 24px horizontal padding, no border-radius (sharp corners signal clinical precision). Secondary: 'Our Materials' — transparent background, 1px Precision Slate border, Precision Slate label. Both buttons sit 40px below the subheadline. On hover: primary deepens and lifts 3px; secondary fills with Suture Gray (#E2E6EA). On mobile, buttons stack vertically, full-width.

**Signature Visual Moment — The Anatomy Baseline:** A 1px horizontal rule in Anatomy Blue (#C8DFF0) spans the full viewport width, positioned precisely at the baseline of the H1 headline — the text rests on this line as though it is a measurement axis on a clinical diagram. The rule begins at the left viewport edge and extends to the right viewport edge, ignoring the content column margins. On the far right of the rule, outside the text column (approximately columns 9–11), a small IBM Plex Mono label reads 'FI-01 / ANATOMICAL FIT SYSTEM' in 11px Precision Slate at 40% opacity — horizontally right-aligned to the viewport right margin, vertically centered on the rule. This annotation is visible only on desktop (≥1024px). The rule and annotation are hidden on mobile.

**Bottom Gradient Bridge:** The bottom 80px of the hero section fades from Forma White to Anatomy Blue (#C8DFF0) via a linear gradient — this is not a section divider but a continuous color transition that makes Section 2 feel like it emerges from the hero rather than beginning separately.

**Motion — On-Load Arc:**
1. Eyebrow label fades in and slides up 8px (approximately 0.4s, ease-out) — first element to appear.
2. H1 headline fades in and slides up 10px a beat after the eyebrow settles (approximately 0.5s, ease-out).
3. Subheadline fades in and slides up 8px a beat after the headline settles (approximately 0.4s).
4. CTA buttons fade in together (no slide) a beat after the subheadline — they simply appear, calm and final.
5. **Signature Motion — The Anatomy Baseline Draw:** After the headline finishes its entrance, the Anatomy Blue rule draws itself from left to right across the full viewport width over approximately 0.8 seconds, as though inscribed by a precise instrument (implemented via a CSS clip-path or width animation on a pseudo-element). The diagram annotation label fades in only after the rule reaches the right edge — a half-beat delay. This is the page's one kinetic flourish.

**Hover affordances:** CTA buttons as described above. No other interactive elements in this section.

**Stillness:** The hero is otherwise completely still. No parallax, no floating elements, no ambient loops. The stillness is the point — the visitor has arrived somewhere serious.

**Section 2 — Stats**

**Layout & Grid:** Full-width section with Anatomy Blue (#C8DFF0) as the background — the palette's 'soft blue' at full expression, carrying forward the gradient wash from the hero. The section has 80px vertical padding top and bottom on desktop, 56px on mobile. Content is centered within the 12-column grid. The section begins immediately where the hero's gradient bridge ends, so no hard edge is visible — the blue simply deepens and becomes the section surface.

**Eyebrow:** IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 11px, letter-spacing 0.15em, Calibration Ink (#1C2B35) at 60% opacity. Text: 'The Forma Standard'. Centered above the headline. 20px below eyebrow to headline.

**Headline (H2):** DM Sans, bold, 36px, Calibration Ink (#1C2B35), tracking -0.02em, centered. Text: 'Numbers that matter to the body.' 32px below headline to stat card row.

**Stat Cards — Grid:** Four cards in a single horizontal row on desktop (4 columns, equal width, 20px gap). On tablet: 2×2 grid. On mobile: single column stack. Each card is a soft white rectangle (Forma White #F7F8F9 surface) with a 1px Suture Gray (#E2E6EA) border and 32px internal padding on all sides. No border-radius — sharp corners consistent with the clinical instrument aesthetic.

**Card Anatomy (per card):**
- Top: IBM Plex Mono label in uppercase, 11px, letter-spacing 0.15em, Rigor Teal (#3A8C7E) — this is the unit or qualifier context (e.g., 'FIT ZONES', 'CERTIFICATION', 'RETENTION', 'TREATMENTS'). Derived from the description text — the designer/compiler should extract the key unit concept.
- Middle: DM Sans, bold, 72–80px desktop / 56px mobile, Calibration Ink (#1C2B35) — the raw numeral or symbol ('6', '100%', '3×', '0'). This is the dominant visual element of the entire section. The numerals are typographic objects at this scale.
- Bottom: IBM Plex Sans, 15px, line-height 1.5, Precision Slate (#3D4F5C) — the description text as provided in the section items.

**Scroll-Triggered Reveal:** As the section enters the viewport (detected by IntersectionObserver), the four stat cards slide up 16px and fade in, staggered left to right — each card begins its animation a half-beat after the previous one. Once a card is fully visible, the large numeral counts up from zero to its final value over approximately one second using a vanilla JS counter. The '100%' card counts from 0 to 100 with a '%' suffix; '3×' counts from 0 to 3 with a '×' suffix; '0' stays at 0 but fades in with the same timing for consistency.

**Hover:** Stat cards are deliberately still on hover — they are data, not interactive elements. No lift, no color shift, no cursor change. This restraint signals that the numbers are facts, not invitations.

**No CTAs in this section.** The section closes cleanly at the bottom with 80px padding, then transitions to the Forma White background of Section 3 via a clean hard edge (no gradient — the contrast between Anatomy Blue and Forma White is intentional and creates a clear section boundary).

**Section 3 — Feature Grid**

**Layout & Grid:** Forma White (#F7F8F9) background. 100px vertical padding top and bottom on desktop, 64px on mobile. 12-column grid. The eyebrow and headline occupy a left-aligned text block in columns 1–6, with 48px of space below before the card grid begins. The three feature cards sit in a 3-column grid (columns 1–4, 5–8, 9–12 on desktop), 24px gap between cards. On mobile: single column stack.

**Eyebrow:** IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 11px, letter-spacing 0.15em, Rigor Teal (#3A8C7E). Text: 'Why Forma Intime'. Left-aligned. 20px below eyebrow to headline.

**Headline (H2):** DM Sans, bold, 40–44px, Calibration Ink (#1C2B35), tracking -0.02em, left-aligned. Text: 'Three principles. No compromises.' Max-width 480px to keep it from spanning the full width — the right half of the header row is empty, creating asymmetric breathing room.

**Feature Cards — Structure:** Each card is Forma White (#F7F8F9) with a 1px Suture Gray (#E2E6EA) border, 32px internal padding, no border-radius. Cards have equal height (set by the tallest card in the row). The card layout is top-to-bottom: icon tray → card title → description text.

**Icon Tray (top of each card):** A small rectangular tray, 48×48px, filled with Intime Mint (#B8E4D8) as the background — not the icon color, but the icon's container/ground. The clinical icon (from the asset ideas: body anatomy, certified fabric swatch, wash-cycle durability loop) sits centered within the tray in Calibration Ink (#1C2B35). The tray is left-aligned within the card (not centered). 24px below the tray to the card title.

**Icon Placement Rationale:** Left-aligned icon trays in Intime Mint give the cards the feel of a clinical form or labeled specimen — each pillar is a documented category, not a marketing bullet. The mint tray color is the only use of Intime Mint in this section, making it a precise accent rather than a wash.

**Card Title (H3):** DM Sans, semibold, 22–24px, Calibration Ink (#1C2B35), sentence case. 16px below title to description.

**Card Description:** IBM Plex Sans, 16px, line-height 1.7, Precision Slate (#3D4F5C). Full text as provided in the section items.

**CTA:** Below the card grid, 40px of space, then a single left-aligned text link: 'Read About Our Materials →'. IBM Plex Sans, medium, 15px, Rigor Teal (#3A8C7E). On hover: the underline grows from left to right (CSS transition on border-bottom or a pseudo-element), and the arrow shifts 4px to the right. No button — this is a link, not an action, and its restraint signals editorial confidence.

**Scroll-Triggered Reveal:** As the section enters the viewport, the three feature cards fade in and slide up 12px, staggered left to right — each card a half-beat after the previous. The icon tray within each card fades in a half-beat after the card itself settles, giving the impression of the card populating with content. The CTA link fades in after all three cards have settled.

**Hover on Cards:** On hover, the card border transitions from Suture Gray (#E2E6EA) to Intime Mint (#B8E4D8) and the card lifts 4px with a clean shadow (no blur, 4px Y offset, 10% opacity black). The icon tray background deepens slightly toward a more saturated mint. Transition: approximately 200ms, ease-out. On keyboard focus: a 2px Rigor Teal outline appears offset 3px from the card edge.

**Density:** This section is the most information-dense on the page but uses generous internal padding to keep it airy. The white surface and Suture Gray borders create clinical structure without visual noise.

**Section 4 — CTA Close**

**Layout & Grid:** Full-bleed Calibration Ink (#1C2B35) background — the darkest, most anchoring surface on the page. This section is a deliberate tonal break from everything above it. 120px vertical padding top and bottom on desktop, 80px on mobile. Content is centered — single column, max-width 640px, horizontally centered in the viewport. This is the one moment of intentional symmetry on the page, justified by the closing-note convention: the visitor has scrolled through the full brand argument and now receives a single, still, confident invitation.

**Eyebrow:** IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, 11px, letter-spacing 0.15em, Intime Mint (#B8E4D8). Text: 'The Current Campaign'. Centered. 24px below eyebrow to headline. The mint eyebrow on the dark ink background creates the highest-contrast eyebrow treatment on the page — it reads as a clinical annotation on a dark specimen board.

**Headline (H2):** DM Sans, bold, 48–52px desktop / 34–38px mobile, Forma Nude (#EDE0D4), tracking -0.02em, sentence case, centered. Text: 'Intimacy is a form of precision.' This is the only instance of a Forma Nude headline on the entire page — and the entire site. The warm skin-toned neutral against the deep Calibration Ink creates a quietly sensual contrast that bridges the clinical precision of the brand with its emotional, body-positive dimension. This typographic color choice is reserved for this exact moment.

**Subheadline:** IBM Plex Sans, 17px, line-height 1.7, Suture Gray (#E2E6EA) at 80% opacity, centered, max-width 520px. Text: 'See how Forma Intime's latest collection was built — from material sourcing to final fit session.' 24px below headline to subheadline.

**CTA Button:** Single centered button, 40px below the subheadline. Label: 'View the Campaign'. Rigor Teal (#3A8C7E) background, Forma White (#F7F8F9) label, DM Sans medium 15px, 52px height, 28px horizontal padding, no border-radius (consistent with the sharp-corner clinical system). On hover: background deepens by ~10%, button lifts 3px with a clean shadow. On keyboard focus: 2px Intime Mint outline offset 3px from the button edge.

**Scroll-Triggered Reveal:** As the section enters the viewport, the content fades in as a whole — no slide, no stagger. The full-bleed dark surface should feel like it arrives with authority, not floats up. Then: eyebrow fades in first, headline a beat later, subheadline a beat after that, CTA button last. Each step is a simple opacity fade, approximately 0.35s each, with a half-beat gap between them. The sequential reveal mimics the rhythm of reading a clinical conclusion.

**No ambient motion.** This section is deliberately still. The Calibration Ink surface, the Forma Nude headline, and the single Rigor Teal button are the entire visual event. Nothing pulses, drifts, or loops. The stillness is the closing gesture — the brand has made its case, and now it waits.

**Bottom edge:** The section extends to the page footer (which is part of the shared system, not this page's design scope). No gradient bridge — the hard edge between Calibration Ink and the footer is intentional and structural.

## Collection Page — Forma Intime: Visual Design Plan

### Page Role & Goal
This is the Collection overview page — a structured, scannable product dashboard that presents Forma Intime's range as a clinical system. The visitor should feel like they are reading a well-organized medical reference, not browsing a fashion lookbook. The page rewards attention and rewards the body-literate, ingredient-conscious visitor who wants to understand what they're buying before they buy it.

---

### Section Sequence & Rhythm

The page moves through four distinct structural registers, each with a different skeleton to prevent templating:

1. **Page Header (collection-section-1):** A wide, asymmetric masthead — left-anchored, typographically dominant, with a horizontal rule and a secondary metadata strip. Deliberately sparse. Sets the tone.
2. **Item Grid (collection-section-2):** A dense, dashboard-style product grid — 3 columns on desktop, with metric-card anatomy: eyebrow label, product name at display weight, material callout in IBM Plex Mono, and a fit-profile badge. A clinical flat-lay diagram asset sits above the grid, full-width, acting as a diagnostic header image. This is the page's densest section.
3. **Comparison Table (collection-section-3):** A structured clinical reference table — the page's most data-forward moment. Side-tabbed layout with fit profiles as row identifiers on the left and attribute columns across the top. Breaks the card-grid rhythm entirely.
4. **CTA Close (collection-section-4):** A saturated Rigor Teal full-bleed panel — a confident, quiet close. Centered composition (justified by the heritage-adjacent closure convention). Two CTAs side by side. Deliberately minimal after the density of sections 2 and 3.

---

### Signature Moment

**Section 2 — The Clinical Diagram Header above the product grid.**

A full-width flat-lay technical diagram of a bra silhouette — rendered in a clinical, anatomical illustration style with labeled fit zones (underwire channel, strap geometry, cup mapping, thoracic anchor) — spans the full content column above the 3-column product grid. The labels are set in IBM Plex Mono, the same accent treatment used for certification badges and metric card labels throughout the design system. The diagram is tinted with a wash of Anatomy Blue (#C8DFF0), giving it the quality of a medical illustration print. This is the page's unmistakable visual identity moment: it signals that Forma Intime treats the body as a precision system, not a decorative surface. The diagram does not sit politely in a corner — it dominates a full horizontal band, bleeding edge-to-edge within the content container, before the grid begins. It is the visual proof-of-concept for everything the grid below claims.

**Signature Motion Moment (tied to this):** As the diagram scrolls into the viewport, the labeled annotation lines draw in from their anchor points outward — each line extending from the silhouette to its label capsule in a staggered sequence, one beat apart, left to right. This mimics the motion of a clinician annotating a diagram in real time, reinforcing the brand's material-science rigor. The effect is subtle, precise, and entirely native to the clinical-health aesthetic.

---

### Color & Surface Logic

- **Section 1 (Page Header):** Forma White (#F7F8F9) background. Precision Slate (#3D4F5C) for all type. A single horizontal rule in Suture Gray (#E2E6EA) divides the masthead from a metadata strip. Rigor Teal (#3A8C7E) appears only on the eyebrow label — its first appearance on the page, used sparingly to establish the accent anchor.
- **Section 2 (Item Grid):** Forma White background. Product cards have Suture Gray (#E2E6EA) borders and white (#F7F8F9) surfaces. Fit-profile badges use Intime Mint (#B8E4D8) as background with Calibration Ink (#1C2B35) text. Material callouts in IBM Plex Mono use Precision Slate. The clinical diagram asset is tinted Anatomy Blue (#C8DFF0). The CTA button at the base of the grid is Rigor Teal with white text.
- **Section 3 (Comparison Table):** Anatomy Blue (#C8DFF0) as the section band background — a structural color block that breaks the white sequence and signals a new register. Table headers in IBM Plex Mono, Calibration Ink. Active/highlighted row uses Intime Mint (#B8E4D8). Grid lines in Suture Gray. This is the page's most deliberate use of a non-white surface mid-page.
- **Section 4 (CTA Close):** Full-bleed Rigor Teal (#3A8C7E) panel. White type throughout. CTA buttons invert to white background with Rigor Teal text, or Calibration Ink border as a ghost variant. The Forma Nude (#EDE0D4) does not appear on this page — it is reserved for testimonial and campaign surfaces on other pages.

---

### Typographic Hierarchy & Expressive Moves

- **H1 (Page Header headline):** DM Sans, 52–58px, bold, -0.02em tracking, sentence case. Left-aligned. The headline "Every style. Every anatomy." is set at near-display scale — the period after each phrase acts as a typographic beat, giving the line a clinical, declarative rhythm.
- **Eyebrow labels:** IBM Plex Mono, 11–12px, uppercase, 0.14em letter-spacing, Rigor Teal. Used consistently across all four sections as the system-level identifier.
- **Section 2 product card titles:** DM Sans, 20–22px, medium weight. Product name is the dominant element in each card.
- **Section 2 material callouts:** IBM Plex Mono, 12px, Precision Slate — treated as technical metadata, not marketing copy.
- **Section 3 table headers:** IBM Plex Mono, 11px, uppercase, 0.16em spacing, Calibration Ink — reads as a clinical data header.
- **Section 4 headline:** DM Sans, 36–40px, bold, centered, white on Rigor Teal.

---

### Density & Whitespace Logic

The page follows a deliberate dense → open rhythm:
- Section 1: Open, airy, generous top padding (80–100px), minimal content.
- Section 2: Dense — diagram + 6-card grid fills the vertical space. Padding between cards is tight (20–24px gap). This is the page's maximum information density.
- Section 3: Structured but readable — the table has clear row height (56–64px) and generous column padding. The Anatomy Blue background provides visual breathing room even as the content is data-rich.
- Section 4: Deliberately minimal — large headline, two CTAs, nothing else. Maximum whitespace within the Rigor Teal panel (80px vertical padding above and below).

---

### Motion Design

**On-Load Arc (Section 1):**
- The page header eyebrow label fades in first, from slightly below its resting position — a gentle 300ms ease.
- A beat after the eyebrow settles, the headline "Every style. Every anatomy." slides up from 12px below and fades in — bold, deliberate.
- The subheadline follows a half-beat later, same motion, slightly slower.
- The horizontal rule below the masthead draws in from left to right — a slow, precise 600ms line-draw that feels like a clinical underline being ruled.
- The metadata strip below the rule fades in last, after the rule completes.

**Scroll-Triggered Reveals:**
- Section 2 clinical diagram: fades in as it enters the viewport, then the annotation lines perform the signature motion (see above).
- Section 2 product cards: stagger in from bottom, one column at a time (left to right), each card sliding up 16px and fading in. The stagger interval is short — cards arrive in a quick cascade, not a slow sequence, reinforcing the dashboard-system feeling.
- Section 3 comparison table: the section background (Anatomy Blue) fades in first as a wash, then the table rows slide in from the left, one by one, top to bottom — mimicking a data table populating.
- Section 4 CTA panel: the full Rigor Teal background fades in, then the headline and CTAs rise up together.

**Hover & Focus Affordances:**
- Product cards (Section 2): on hover, the card lifts 4px, the Suture Gray border transitions to Intime Mint, and the fit-profile badge brightens slightly. The transition is quick — 180ms ease-out. Keyboard focus mirrors the hover state with a visible Rigor Teal outline.
- Comparison table rows (Section 3): on hover, the row background transitions from transparent to a very light Anatomy Blue tint. Active/highlighted row retains its Intime Mint background.
- CTA buttons: the primary Rigor Teal button on hover shifts to Calibration Ink background — a confident, dark inversion. The ghost/secondary button fills with white at low opacity. Both transitions are 150ms.

**Ambient Looped Motion:**
- None on this page. The clinical-health aesthetic demands restraint. The signature motion moment (annotation line draw) is the only kinetic flourish. The page is otherwise still and confident. A pulsing CTA or drifting gradient would undermine the clinical authority the brand requires.

---

### Responsive Behavior

- **Desktop (1280px+):** 3-column product grid, full-width diagram, side-tabbed comparison table.
- **Tablet (768–1279px):** 2-column product grid, diagram scales to full container width, comparison table collapses to a scrollable horizontal table with sticky left column (fit profile names).
- **Mobile (<768px):** 1-column product grid, diagram stacks above grid with pinch-zoom affordance, comparison table becomes a vertically stacked card format — each fit profile is its own card with attributes listed below the name. CTA close panel stacks CTAs vertically.

---

### Cross-Page Fit

This page is the most data-dense page in the site. It sits between the brand-establishing Home page and the editorial Materials page. Its clinical dashboard register is the fullest expression of the layout_family's structure_cues (metric cards, feature panels, comparison tables) applied to a fashion context. The Anatomy Blue section band in Section 3 and the Rigor Teal close panel in Section 4 are the two major color departures from the white baseline — both are earned by the content register they host. The IBM Plex Mono accent treatment runs consistently through all four sections, tying the page to the shared design system's accent_treatment specification.

## Materials Page — Full Design Direction

### Page Role & Tone
This is an editorial-trust page: the visitor is ingredient-conscious, skeptical of marketing language, and rewards transparency. The visual register must feel like a well-produced clinical reference document — structured, measured, quietly confident — not a lifestyle brand's "sustainability" marketing page. Every layout decision should signal rigor.

---

### Signature Visual Moment
**The Fabric Data Panel in Section 3 (feature_grid)** is the page's signature moment. The four material cards are arranged as a clinical data dashboard: each card carries an oversized, left-aligned two-digit index numeral (01, 02, 03, 04) rendered in Calibration Ink at approximately 80px / DM Sans Bold, functioning as a structural anchor rather than decoration. These numerals bleed partially behind the card's top edge, creating a layered depth effect that recalls clinical specimen labeling. The horizontal bar chart asset sits flush below the four cards as a full-width data module in Anatomy Blue (#C8DFF0), visually separated from the cards by a 2px Suture Gray rule — the whole assembly reads as a single dashboard panel. This is the clinical-dashboard layout family expressed at full amplitude for a lingerie brand: data cards with specimen numbers, a comparative chart, and certification badges rendered in IBM Plex Mono, all on a Forma White surface.

**Signature Motion Moment:** As Section 3 enters the viewport, the four index numerals (01–04) count up from 00 to their final value in a quick, staggered ticker animation — each numeral resolving a beat after the previous one. This is the only "data animation" on the page and it happens once, on scroll entry, reinforcing the clinical-documentation character of the section.

---

### Section Sequence & Rhythm

1. **Page Header (Section 1):** Sparse, authoritative masthead. Left-aligned, wide. Dense type block with generous top padding. Anatomy Blue left-border accent rule (4px vertical rule). Sets clinical tone immediately.
2. **Story Block (Section 2):** Editorial prose column — asymmetric, off-center. Forma Nude (#EDE0D4) background panel that spans ~60% of the page width, flush right, while the left column holds the eyebrow and headline in open white space. Slow, deliberate read. Deliberately still section.
3. **Feature Grid (Section 3):** The page's densest, most data-rich section. Forma White surface. Four material data cards + full-width bar chart below. Signature moment lives here.
4. **CTA (Section 4):** Calm, minimal close. Rigor Teal (#3A8C7E) full-bleed background panel. Centered composition (justified by the terminal/close convention). Generous whitespace. One action.

The density arc: sparse → editorial → dense data → sparse release. This mirrors a clinical report's structure: abstract → methodology → data → conclusion.

---

### Color & Surface Logic
- **Section 1 (Page Header):** Forma White (#F7F8F9) background. Precision Slate (#3D4F5C) for headline and body. Anatomy Blue (#C8DFF0) for the vertical accent rule and the eyebrow label background chip. Calibration Ink (#1C2B35) for the large headline.
- **Section 2 (Story Block):** Forma White left zone + Forma Nude (#EDE0D4) right panel (~60% width, flush right). Precision Slate for body copy. Rigor Teal for the eyebrow label. Suture Gray (#E2E6EA) for the horizontal rule separating the intro from the body text.
- **Section 3 (Feature Grid):** Forma White surface. Calibration Ink for oversized index numerals. Anatomy Blue (#C8DFF0) for the chart module background below the cards. Intime Mint (#B8E4D8) for certification badge chips. Suture Gray for card borders and grid lines. Rigor Teal for the bar chart's filled bars.
- **Section 4 (CTA):** Rigor Teal (#3A8C7E) full-bleed background. Forma White for all text and the CTA button (outlined, white border, white label). This is the only section where Rigor Teal dominates an entire surface — it reads as the confident close.

Accent color (Rigor Teal) appears on: eyebrow labels, bar chart bars, and the full-bleed CTA section — not only on buttons.

---

### Typographic Hierarchy
- **DM Sans** for all headings: H1 at 52–56px (Section 1 headline), H2 at 36–40px (Section 2 headline), H3 at 24–26px (card titles in Section 3), CTA headline at 40px (Section 4).
- **IBM Plex Sans** for all body copy: 16–18px, 1.7 line-height. Used in Section 2 (long-form prose) and card descriptions in Section 3.
- **IBM Plex Mono** in uppercase, 11–12px, letter-spacing 0.14em: eyebrow labels in all sections, certification badge text, card metadata labels, chart axis labels, and the "origin" field in material cards.
- Tracking on headlines: -0.02em (DM Sans default tightening). Body copy: 0em tracking.
- Section 2 uses a pull-quote typographic move: the opening sentence of the body copy ("When Forma Intime was founded…") is set at 22px IBM Plex Sans Medium, Precision Slate, separated from the rest of the body by a thin Suture Gray rule — functioning as a documentary lead-in.

---

### Density & Whitespace Logic
- Section 1: 120px top padding, 80px bottom. Open. Single text column, left-aligned, max-width 760px.
- Section 2: 96px vertical padding. Asymmetric split — left 40% white, right 60% Forma Nude panel. Body text column max-width 560px, right-aligned within the nude panel.
- Section 3: 80px top padding, 64px between cards and chart, 80px bottom. Four cards in a 2×2 grid on desktop, full-width chart module below. Card internal padding 32px.
- Section 4: 96px vertical padding. Centered. Constrained to 640px max-width text block on the Teal background.

---

### Motion Design (Human Terms, Calibrated to Editorial/Clinical Register — 3–4 moments total)

**On-Load Arc (Section 1):**
- The 4px vertical Anatomy Blue accent rule on the left of the headline block draws downward from top to full height over about 0.4 seconds as the page loads — a single, quiet structural gesture that signals the page is "opening."
- A beat after the rule completes, the eyebrow label fades in (opacity 0 → 1, slight upward drift of 8px).
- A beat after that, the headline slides in from left (8px offset) and settles. The subheadline follows a beat later with the same motion. The page is fully settled within about 1.2 seconds of load.

**Scroll-Triggered Reveals:**
- Section 2: The Forma Nude right panel slides in from the right edge (24px offset, opacity 0 → 1) as the section enters the viewport. The left-side headline and eyebrow fade in simultaneously. The body prose block fades in a beat after the panel settles. Deliberately slow and calm — no stagger on individual lines.
- Section 3: The four material cards stagger in from bottom (12px offset, opacity 0 → 1), each card entering 80ms after the previous. After all four cards are visible, the chart module below fades in as a single block. **Signature motion moment:** As each card enters, its oversized index numeral ticks up from 00 to its final value (01, 02, 03, 04) in a quick counter animation — each takes about 300ms and resolves before the next card's numeral begins. This happens once on scroll entry, never loops.
- Section 4: The Teal panel fades in (opacity 0 → 1, no movement — the color is the arrival). The headline and CTA button fade in sequentially a beat after.

**Hover Affordances:**
- Material cards (Section 3): On hover, the card lifts 4px with a soft shadow deepening (no color change on the card surface). The certification badge chip in Intime Mint brightens slightly (opacity increase). Transition is quick — about 180ms ease-out.
- CTA button (Section 4): On hover, the white outlined button fills with a very subtle Forma White at 15% opacity inside, and the label shifts to Calibration Ink — signaling interactivity without aggression. Transition about 160ms.
- Navigation items (global): Not specified here — handled by shared design system.

**Ambient Looped Motion:**
- None. This page is deliberately still between interactions. The clinical editorial register does not support ambient looping. The signature counter animation is the only "active" motion moment and it is triggered once by scroll, not looped.

---

### Responsive Behavior
- **Desktop (≥1280px):** Full asymmetric layouts as described. Four material cards in 2×2 grid. Chart full-width below.
- **Tablet (768–1279px):** Section 2 stacks vertically — Forma Nude panel becomes full-width below the headline block. Material cards shift to 2×1 (two columns, two rows). Chart remains full-width.
- **Mobile (<768px):** All sections single-column. Section 2 Forma Nude panel full-width, headline above. Material cards single-column stack. Chart scrolls horizontally within its container (overflow-x scroll) rather than collapsing the bars. Section 4 CTA centered, full-width button.

---

### Fit Within Shared Design System
This page uses all eight palette colors with clear purpose: Forma White (ground), Anatomy Blue (structural accents and chart background), Intime Mint (certification badges), Precision Slate (body text), Suture Gray (borders and rules), Forma Nude (story block warmth), Rigor Teal (eyebrows, chart bars, CTA section), Calibration Ink (headline anchors and index numerals). ## Campaign Page — Forma Intime: Full Page Design Direction

### Page Role & Emotional Arc
This page is the brand's most human document — a clinical case study that opens into something unexpectedly intimate. The design must hold two registers simultaneously: the methodical rigor of a research dossier and the quiet warmth of a portrait session. The visitor should feel they are reading something that was made carefully, not marketed to them. Every layout decision reinforces that tension.

### Section Sequence & Rhythm
The page moves through four beats with deliberate density variation:
1. **Hero** — maximum impact, sparse typography, full-bleed atmospheric surface. Dense emotional statement, minimal visual noise.
2. **Story Block** — long-form editorial, unhurried. Wide measure, generous whitespace, side-anchored structural annotation. The page breathes here.
3. **Item Grid** — structured, data-forward. Returns to dashboard density with metric cards and clinical illustration. The most visually complex section.
4. **Testimonial** — warm, sparse, ambient. Nude-toned surface, wide-set quotes, no data. The page exhales.

The alternation is: dense/sparse/dense/sparse — never two identical surface textures or structural densities in sequence.

### Signature Moment
**The headline "Intimacy is a form of precision." in the hero section is the page's signature typographic moment.** The word "precision." is set at display scale (64px, DM Sans Bold) and bleeds slightly beyond the left grid margin — off-axis, not centered — while the rest of the headline sits at normal measure. The word "precision." is rendered in Rigor Teal (#3A8C7E), creating a single saturated color strike against the Anatomy Blue (#C8DFF0) hero wash. This is a clinical-health signature: not a loud graphic gesture, but a weight-and-color contrast that feels inevitable — the brand's core claim made typographic. No other element on the page uses this color at this scale.

### Signature Motion Moment
**On page load, the word "precision." in the hero headline enters last — a beat after the rest of the headline has settled — sliding in from 8px below its baseline and fading up, landing with a subtle weight that makes it feel like a conclusion being confirmed rather than a word arriving.** This is the only entrance animation with directional movement; everything else fades or reveals. The motion is restrained (150–200ms ease-out), calibrated to the editorial/clinical aesthetic. It draws the eye to the teal word without theatrics.

### Color & Surface Logic Across Sections
- **Hero**: Anatomy Blue (#C8DFF0) gradient wash as full-bleed background, fading to Forma White (#F7F8F9) at the base. Calibration Ink (#1C2B35) for headline body. Rigor Teal (#3A8C7E) for the word "precision." only.
- **Story Block**: Forma White (#F7F8F9) surface. Precision Slate (#3D4F5C) for body copy. A left-rail vertical rule in Suture Gray (#E2E6EA) anchors the editorial column. The eyebrow label uses IBM Plex Mono in Rigor Teal at 12px uppercase.
- **Item Grid**: Suture Gray (#E2E6EA) section background — the dashboard register returns. Metric cards use Forma White (#F7F8F9) surfaces with Suture Gray borders. Intime Mint (#B8E4D8) used as background tint on metadata badge chips. The clinical illustration sits at the right edge of the grid, partially overlapping the last card column.
- **Testimonial**: Forma Nude (#EDE0D4) full-bleed surface — the warmest surface on the page. Precision Slate (#3D4F5C) for quote text. No borders, no cards. Wide-set, unhurried.

### Typographic Hierarchy
- **Eyebrow labels**: IBM Plex Mono, 11–12px, uppercase, 0.14em letter-spacing, Rigor Teal — used consistently as the documentary register across all four sections.
- **Hero headline**: DM Sans Bold, 56–64px, Calibration Ink, sentence case, tight tracking (-0.02em). "precision." in Rigor Teal at same scale.
- **Hero subheadline**: IBM Plex Sans, 18–20px, Precision Slate, 1.65 line-height.
- **Story Block headline**: DM Sans Medium, 36–40px, Precision Slate.
- **Story Block body**: IBM Plex Sans, 17–18px, Precision Slate, 1.75 line-height, 65-character measure.
- **Item Grid headline**: DM Sans Medium, 32–36px, Calibration Ink.
- **Item card titles**: DM Sans SemiBold, 18px, Calibration Ink.
- **Item card body**: IBM Plex Sans, 15–16px, Precision Slate.
- **Metadata badge labels**: IBM Plex Mono, 11px, uppercase, Precision Slate on Intime Mint background.
- **Testimonial headline**: DM Sans Medium, 32–36px, Precision Slate.
- **Quote text**: IBM Plex Sans Italic, 19–21px, Precision Slate, 1.75 line-height.
- **Attribution**: IBM Plex Mono, 12px, uppercase, 0.12em spacing, Precision Slate at 70% opacity.

### Density & Whitespace Logic
- Hero: sparse — large type, minimal elements, no clutter.
- Story Block: generous — long paragraph, side annotation, deliberate negative space above and below.
- Item Grid: moderate density — 2×2 card grid, illustration overlap, metric badges. Feels structured, not crowded.
- Testimonial: very sparse — three quotes stacked vertically with wide top/bottom padding, no borders or containers.

### Motion Design — Full Page
**On-load arc (Hero):**
1. The Anatomy Blue gradient wash fades in over the hero surface (very fast, near-instant, 100ms).
2. The eyebrow label ("Current Campaign — Forma Intime S/S") fades in first.
3. A beat later, the headline body ("Intimacy is a form of") fades up from 6px below.
4. A beat after that, "precision." slides in from 8px below its baseline and fades up — the signature motion moment.
5. The subheadline fades in a half-beat after "precision." settles.
6. The CTA button fades in last, completing the sequence.
All transitions use ease-out curves. Total arc: approximately 1.2–1.5 seconds from page load.

**Scroll-triggered reveals:**
- Story Block: the editorial column fades up as it enters the viewport. The left-rail vertical rule draws downward (height animates from 0 to full) simultaneously. Children (eyebrow, headline, body) do not stagger — they arrive together, respecting the slow editorial pace.
- Item Grid: the section headline fades up first, then the four cards stagger-fade in left-to-right (each card a short beat after the previous). The clinical illustration fades in last, after the cards have settled.
- Testimonial: the three quotes fade up sequentially, each a beat after the previous, from bottom. Attribution lines follow each quote.

**Hover affordances:**
- CTA button (Explore the Collection): background shifts from Rigor Teal to a slightly deeper teal, and the button lifts 3px with a soft shadow. Transition: quick, 180ms ease-out.
- Item cards in the grid: card lifts 4px, border color shifts from Suture Gray to Anatomy Blue, shadow deepens softly. Transition: 200ms ease-out.
- Testimonial quotes: no hover state — deliberately still, respecting the ambient warmth register.

**Ambient looped motion:**
- None. This page is deliberately still beyond its entrance and scroll reveals. The clinical-editorial aesthetic demands restraint. A single slow ambient gradient shift on the hero background (a very subtle, slow 8-second pulse between two adjacent Anatomy Blue tones) is the only looped motion — barely perceptible, like a slow breath. This is the only concession to ambient animation.

### Responsive Behavior
- **Mobile (< 768px)**: Hero headline drops to 38–44px. Story Block becomes single column, left-rail rule removed, body text at 16px. Item Grid collapses to single column (2×1 stacked cards). Illustration moves above the cards at full width. Testimonial quotes stack vertically at full width with generous vertical padding.
- **Tablet (768–1024px)**: Item Grid becomes 2×2. Story Block annotation moves inline above body. Hero headline at 48–52px.
- **Desktop (≥ 1024px)**: Full layout as described. Maximum content width 1200px, centered, with 80–100px horizontal padding on the outer container.

### Fit Within Shared Design System
This page uses all eight palette colors purposefully: Forma White (Story Block surface, card surfaces), Anatomy Blue (hero wash), Intime Mint (metadata badges), Precision Slate (body copy, testimonial text), Suture Gray (card borders, item grid background, rule lines), Forma Nude (testimonial background), Rigor Teal (eyebrow labels, CTA, signature "precision." word), Calibration Ink (hero headline, item grid headline, hero navigation). The typography stack (DM Sans / IBM Plex Sans / IBM Plex Mono) is used at every prescribed scale. No new motifs are introduced — the clinical illustration in Section 3 is grounded in the asset_ideas specification. The page is consistent with the dashboard_product layout family through its item grid and metric card structure, while its editorial sections (Story Block, Testimonial) give it the human warmth the campaign role demands.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
**Stockists Page — Full Design Direction**

**Page Role & Tone**
This is a functional support page whose job is to help a visitor find Forma Intime in the physical world. The clinical-health aesthetic is expressed here not as decoration but as organizational clarity: every piece of information is structured, labeled, and easy to scan. The tone is direct and reassuring — a well-formatted reference document, not a sales pitch. The dashboard-product layout family surfaces through structured data cards, consistent metadata fields, and a geographic data-visualization moment in the header.

**Section Sequence & Rhythm**
Four sections create a deliberate dense → airy → dense → focused rhythm:
1. **Page Header** — Full-width, asymmetric, data-dense opening with a live dot-plot map asset and a masthead-style typographic treatment. High information density, no hero padding waste.
2. **European Stockists Grid** — Four structured data cards in a 2×2 grid. Clinical card format with labeled metadata fields. Anatomy Blue surface tint on the section band.
3. **North American Stockists Grid** — Three cards in a 3-column row on desktop. Forma White surface. Deliberately sparser than the European section to create rhythmic contrast and signal a shorter list.
4. **Contact Block** — A contained, off-center panel on a Forma Nude background. Quiet, warm close. Rigor Teal CTA as the only saturated element on the page's final screen.

**Color & Surface Logic**
- Section 1 (Header): Forma White (#F7F8F9) background with a full-width Anatomy Blue (#C8DFF0) horizontal band behind the map asset — the band reads as a clinical data panel, not a decorative wash.
- Section 2 (Europe): Anatomy Blue (#C8DFF0) at low opacity (≈15%) as a section background tint, distinguishing it from the white body of the page.
- Section 3 (North America): Forma White (#F7F8F9) — clean return to the base canvas, creating visual breathing room.
- Section 4 (Contact): Forma Nude (#EDE0D4) full-bleed background — the warmest surface on the page, reserved for this closing human moment.
- Suture Gray (#E2E6EA) is used consistently for card borders, rule lines, and metadata dividers throughout sections 2 and 3.
- Rigor Teal (#3A8C7E) appears on: the CTA button in section 4, the map pin dots in section 1's asset, the "fit consultation available" badge indicator on stockist cards, and the eyebrow labels in sections 2 and 3.
- Calibration Ink (#1C2B35) anchors all headlines and the navigation bar.
- Precision Slate (#3D4F5C) carries all body copy and card descriptions.

**Typographic Hierarchy**
- DM Sans Bold at 52px for the H1 headline in section 1, set left-aligned, sentence case, -0.02em tracking. The headline "Find Forma Intime near you." is set in two lines, with "near you." pushed to a second line for rhythmic emphasis.
- IBM Plex Mono uppercase at 11px, 0.14em letter-spacing for all eyebrow labels ("Where to Buy", "Europe", "North America", "Retail Partnerships") — this monospaced register is the clinical-documentation signal throughout.
- DM Sans Medium at 20px for card titles (stockist names).
- IBM Plex Sans at 16px / 1.7 line-height for card descriptions.
- IBM Plex Mono at 12px for metadata field labels ("Fit Consultation:", "Range:") — maintaining the clinical-record register.
- IBM Plex Sans at 14px for metadata values.
- DM Sans SemiBold at 36px for section 4's headline.

**Signature Moment — The Geographic Data Panel**
The page's signature visual moment is the **full-width clinical map panel** embedded in the page header (section 1). Rather than a decorative illustration, the map is rendered as a pure data artifact: a minimal outline of Europe and North America in Suture Gray lines on an Anatomy Blue background band, with Rigor Teal circular data points marking each stockist city. Each dot is accompanied by a small IBM Plex Mono city label. The map occupies the right two-thirds of the header on desktop, while the headline and subheadline stack left — an asymmetric masthead split that gives the page its clinical-dashboard opening. This move is inevitable for this aesthetic: a clinical brand with a global retail footprint presents its geographic data the way a medical network presents its clinic locations — as a precise, documented system, not a lifestyle photograph.

**Signature Motion Moment — Map Dot Reveal**
On page load, the Rigor Teal stockist dots on the map appear one by one in a staggered sequence, each dot scaling from 0 to full size with a quick, precise pop (not a bounce — a clean scale-in). The dots appear in geographic order: left to right, Europe first, then North America, completing the sequence about one second after the headline has settled. This motion reinforces the clinical-documentation register: data points being plotted, not decorative animation.

**Motion Design — Full Arc**

*On-load arc:*
- The IBM Plex Mono eyebrow ("Where to Buy") fades in first, over about a third of a second, as the page arrives.
- A beat later, the H1 headline slides up 12px and fades in over about half a second.
- The subheadline follows immediately after the headline settles, fading in at a slightly slower pace.
- The Anatomy Blue map panel fades in as a whole surface, then — about a beat after the panel is visible — the Suture Gray map outlines draw in (a subtle opacity fade, not a path-draw, to stay within CSS constraints).
- The Rigor Teal city dots then appear in staggered sequence (the named signature motion moment), each dot scaling from zero with a crisp 150ms pop, spaced about 80ms apart, left to right.

*Scroll-triggered reveals:*
- Section 2 (Europe): The section eyebrow and headline fade up as the section enters the viewport. The four stockist cards then stagger in — each card slides up 16px and fades in, with a short delay between each (top-left → top-right → bottom-left → bottom-right). This is wired with IntersectionObserver.
- Section 3 (North America): Same stagger pattern, three cards left to right.
- Section 4 (Contact): The entire panel fades in and scales very subtly from 98% to 100% as it enters the viewport — a single composed entrance, no stagger.

*Hover affordances:*
- Stockist cards: on hover, the card lifts 4px, the Suture Gray border transitions to Anatomy Blue, and the card's drop shadow deepens slightly. The transition is quick (around 180ms). On keyboard focus, the same lift and border-color change apply.
- The "Send a Partnership Enquiry" CTA button: on hover, the Rigor Teal background deepens by about 10% toward Calibration Ink, and the button lifts 2px. On keyboard focus, a 2px Rigor Teal outline offset appears.
- Fit consultation badge indicators (the small Rigor Teal dot/pill on each card): on card hover, the badge transitions its background from Intime Mint to Rigor Teal at full opacity, reinforcing the interactive state.

*Ambient motion:*
- The Rigor Teal map dots in the header have a very slow, subtle pulse — a gentle opacity oscillation between 85% and 100% on a 3-second loop — suggesting live, active data points. This is the only looped ambient motion on the page, calibrated to the clinical-calm aesthetic. It is quiet enough to not distract but present enough to make the map feel like a live reference system.

*Motion intensity calibration:* This is an editorial/support page for a clinical brand. Motion is restrained — 4–5 moments total, all purposeful, none decorative. The signature motion (map dot reveal) is the most kinetic moment; everything else is understated.

**Density & Whitespace Logic**
- Section 1: Dense. The header packs headline, subheadline, and a full geographic data panel into one band without generous padding. This signals "functional page, information starts now."
- Sections 2 & 3: Moderate density. Cards have comfortable internal padding (24px) but the grid gutters are tight (16–20px) to maintain the clinical-record feel. No decorative whitespace between cards.
- Section 4: Sparse. The contact block is a contained panel (max-width 680px) centered on the Forma Nude band with generous vertical padding above and below. The sparseness signals "this is the end — take your time."

**Responsive Behavior**
- Desktop (≥1280px): Section 1 is a 60/40 asymmetric split (text left, map right). Sections 2 and 3 use a 2-column and 3-column grid respectively. Section 4 is a centered narrow panel.
- Tablet (768–1279px): Section 1 stacks — map moves below the text. Sections 2 and 3 both collapse to 2-column grids. Section 4 remains centered.
- Mobile (<768px): All grids collapse to single column. Section 1 map asset appears below the headline as a full-width panel. Section 4 CTA button spans full width. Eyebrow labels and metadata remain in IBM Plex Mono at 11px — never scaled down further.

**Cross-Page Consistency**
This page shares the IBM Plex Mono eyebrow convention, Rigor Teal CTAs, Suture Gray card borders, and DM Sans headline scale with all other Forma Intime pages. It is the only page that uses the Anatomy Blue map panel as a full-bleed structural element — that specificity is what makes it feel like its own composition within the system.
